summary:
Iteration 25 — Admin 會員管理 redesign + nav reordering verified end-to-end. Backend: 7/7 pytest passed in /app/backend/tests/test_members_redesign.py (JUnit at /app/test_reports/pytest/iter25_results.xml). Covered (1) GET /api/admin/members/stats returns {total, active, new, banned} all int, missing X-Admin-Token → 401 admin_2fa_required. (2) GET /api/admin/members rows all carry account_no (9-digit numeric str), order_count(int), spent_usd(float), balance_usd(float), banned(bool); list↔detail account_no agree. (3) GET /api/admin/members/{uid} returns new fields account_no, verified(bool), order_count(int), spent_usd(float) + orders/transactions/banned. Unknown uid → 404. (4) Ban → detail.banned=true + stats.banned increments; unban rollback → false.

Frontend (zh-CN, 1920x1080): logged in via /admin/login (email+password + TOTP via pyotp from /tmp/admin_totp_secret). Sidebar NAV order verified programmatically: [overview, members, payments, currencies, topups, …] — 會員管理 is SECOND ✓. On 會員管理: 4 stat cards (總用戶=9, 活躍用戶=3, 近30天新增=5, 封禁用戶=0) ✓, members-table shows 9 rows with 帳戶ID (bold mono: 106965390, 114141253, 105908808, 111176521, 116482719, …), avatar initial circle (gradient), 會員 email/name, 手機號, 等級 badge (普通會員 / 白銀會員 for tester $827.41), 訂單數/消費, 餘額 (bold), 註冊時間, 狀態 badge 正常/封禁, 詳情 button ✓. Clicking 詳情 opens member-detail drawer with: dark header + gradient avatar, 已實名認證 / 未實名 badge, 高價值用戶 badge (hidden when spend<1000), 基本信息 (帳戶ID 106965390, 手機號, 信箱, 等級 pill, Google, 註冊時間, 最近登入), 帳戶數據 (帳戶餘額, 累計消費, 訂單數), ban (red) + 重置密碼 buttons, 餘額調整 card with wallet-kind-credit/debit/refund tabs + wallet-adjust-amount/note/submit, 最近訂單 + 最近錢包流水 lists ✓. Search 'admin' → 2 rows, members-clear → 9. members-tab-banned → 0 rows (no banned users). Regression: /admin/topups topup-member-<id> link opens the same MemberDetail drawer (24 links present, first click opens drawer) ✓.

critical_code_review_comments: admin_member_detail at admin_api.py:247 computes balance_usd TWICE: once via wallet_transactions.find({'amount_usd':1}).to_list(10000) for the sum, while the drawer also uses the aggregation in /admin/members list. The inline list-comp materialises every tx into memory. For a heavy user this is O(n). Prefer a single $group aggregation like the /members list already uses ($match user_id → $group sum amount_usd).

MembersAdmin.jsx:134 — useLoad watches `/admin/members?q=${encodeURIComponent(qq)}` with qq in the URL; this is fine, but there is no debounce — a fast typer who then clicks members-search-btn will race the previous request. Non-blocking.

MembersAdmin.jsx:182 shows u.spent_usd.toFixed(2) without null-guard — safe because backend always rounds and returns 0.0, but if a future row misses the field the row will throw and crash the table render. Consider `Number(u.spent_usd||0).toFixed(2)` for defensive rendering (same pattern already used in the detail panel at line 101).

The 封禁用戶 stat card label is dynamic via tr('封禁用戶') — data-testid uses the raw src ('封禁用戶') which means Chinese data-testid values travel to the DOM. Works but non-ASCII selectors can bite CI tools that URL-encode selectors. Prefer stable ascii keys for data-testid (e.g. member-stat-banned).

rca of the issue: N/A — redesign spec fully implemented. Only cosmetic suggestions: (a) use ASCII keys for member-stat-* data-testid instead of Chinese label; (b) collapse balance_usd computation in admin_member_detail to a single aggregation.
